name: Dante, Hemomancer deals X unpreventable damage to himself, rests, and empowers by X
notes: Regression test for a fixed bug: the printed cost is '(X), [REST]:' but activating the ability never rested the champion (see the case "4FtNBFaOJp" block in GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php's ActivatedAbilityCost, which now sets Status = 1 the same way the existing Bedlam Borough [REST] cost case does). Dante, Hemomancer's own activated ability is champion-identity-gated (a card-ID switch case, not the generic element-lineage system), so the starting champion object's CardID itself is patched directly to Dante, Hemomancer rather than only patching Subcards. Activating it opens a NUMBERCHOOSE for X (answered via the plain numeric cardID '2', per this engine's NUMBERCHOOSE answer convention), rests the champion, then pays X reserve, then a reactive opportunity window (declined via PASS) before the ability deals X unpreventable damage to Dante and empowers him by X.

rulesClauses: (X), [REST]: Deal X unpreventable damage to Dante and empower X. X can't be 0 or greater than 4.
